priorityList: In the opener, use Blade of Justice and Judgment to apply Expurgation and the Judgment debuff before using major cooldowns.
Use Execution Sentence when Wake of Ashes is ready and Avenging Wrath is active or soon to be available.
Use Avenging Wrath (or Crusade) as long as Expurgation is ticking on the target.
Cast Hammer of Light whenever it is available, prioritizing it during Avenging Wrath or if the free proc is about to expire.
Cast Templar's Verdict (or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active) to spend Holy Power if at 5 Holy Power or if the Hammer of Light free proc is expiring.
Use Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or if Execution Sentence is already on cooldown.
Use Divine Toll if Avenging Wrath is active or has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Use Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs occur.
Spend Holy Power (3+) on Templar's Verdict, or Divine Storm if Empyrean Power is active.
Use Hammer of Wrath as a high-priority generator, especially if talented into Walk into Light.
Use Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Use Judgment to generate Holy Power.
Use Templar Strike, Templar Slash, or Crusader Strike as filler generators.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities (like Fireblood or Light's Judgment) during Avenging Wrath or Execution Sentence windows.
